correctness.rationale: The seven points V=F2^3\{0} with Fano lines {a,b,a XOR b} define the full 2187 ternary input domain and 882 weak proper assignments (no monochromatic line). Inclusion-exclusion over all 2^7=128 line subsets gives exact W(k)=sum_J(-1)^|J|3^c(J) product_{blocks B}1_{sum_B k=0 mod3}, an integer for every character. Diagonal colour translation kills the 1458 unbalanced frequencies. GL(3,2) has 168 line-preserving permutations; combined with negation it partitions the 729 balanced characters into the table's 12 classes, each independently evaluated from the inclusion-exclusion formula to nonzero values {882,-171,-90,72,18,-9}. Independently reimplemented the 128 partitions and evaluated all 2187 Fourier vectors in exact integer arithmetic; reproduced histogram multiplicities 1,14,42,56,252,364,1458. This is genuinely exhaustive for a fixed finite domain. Fourier diagonalization yields rank729, sharp inverse norm1/9 and condition number 882/9=98.
